theorems.name: Submission.idod_monotone_quantity_eventually_lt
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (y : Euclid P) (Λ θ θ₁ : ℝ), HasMassDensity T y θ → θ < θ₁ → ∀ᶠ ρ in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (Λ * ρ) / ρ ^ n) * T.massOn (ball y ρ) < unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal θ₁
